# Check that both arms exist and are balanced
print("Arm distribution:", df['arm'].value_counts())

# Compute response rate by arm
treatment_responders = df[df['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].sum()
treatment_total = len(df[df['arm'] == 'treatment'])
treatment_rate = treatment_responders / treatment_total

control_responders = df[df['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].sum()
control_total = len(df[df['arm'] == 'control'])
control_rate = control_responders / control_total

# Compute difference in proportions
treatment_effect = treatment_rate - control_rate

# Print results
treatment_responders, treatment_total, treatment_rate, control_responders, control_total, control_rate, treatment_effect"}
